{{Quote|All the finest, all the first.|Loronar Corporation's logo|<ref name="POT" />}}
The '''Loronar Corporation''' was a major diversified firm based out of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] with primary holdings in defense, [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and mining operations. With a reputation for exceptional corporate greed, Loronar had a storied history of manipulation and exploitation in the pursuit of profit.

==History==
For millennia, Loronar produced a wide variety of products, but was best known for its military hardware produced through its [[Loronar Defense Industries]] subsidiary. The Loronar range of products contained everything from [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] weapons to [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. Loronar's products were sold to governments, [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], private interests and any other party willing to pay the price.

After the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Loronar was quick to align itself with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], but was also responsible for arming [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and even turned five hundred percent profit in ten years of arming them.<ref name="POT" /> During the military build up that followed the establishment of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Loronar received a lucrative contract for the production of capital ships like the versatile [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] and massive [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Spheres]].

Over time, Loronar gained a reputation for corruption, initiating riots on [[Ampliquen]], staging a coup on [[King's Galquek]] and committing rights violations in the [[Gantho system/Legends|Gantho system]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> With the death of Palpatine and the decay of the Empire, Loronar, under the leadership of then-CEO [[Gnifmak Dymurra]], aligned itself with [[Seti Ashgad/Legends|Seti Ashgad]] in his bid for power in the Meridian sector. After subduing the revolt and returning the Loronar-abused [[tsil]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] penalized Loronar heavily and brought those responsible for known crimes to justice. Loronar came close to bankruptcy.

Despite this, the New Republic came to rely on the conglomerate for military supplies as the Empire and Old Republic had before it. It fulfilled several major defense contracts and worked with the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] in funding [[The Nerfworks]], a think tank specializing in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] design projects.
